integrity: Exact proof and standalone Python checks; finite tests corroborate but cannot replace the infinite argument. Earlier Cartesian product results for square-order paths are credited.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary vertex burning of \(K_m\square P_n\), for integers \(m\ge3\) and \(n\ge1\); not clique width two, strong products, higher-factor products, or other burning variants. Independent publication priority is unverified.
title: Exact burning thresholds for Cartesian clique–path graphs
